def round_up_hours(cell_value):

        return None
    
    # If it's a timedelta object (openpyxl often converts time cells)

        total_seconds = cell_value.days * 86400 + cell_value.seconds + cell_value.microseconds / 1000000

        if abs(total_hours - round(total_hours)) < 1e-9:
